purpose: Recover the final decimal-divisor wrapper in the scene-transition counter digit family.

shared_helper.name: SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit
shared_helper.contract: Consumes D4 as the decimal divisor, extracts and emits one counter digit, and returns through the transition formatter.

boundary_basis: The entry is the aligned move-immediate divisor instruction immediately after the tens wrapper.
Its six bytes end immediately before SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit.
